rongmei.title: He tingkao thanmei ning e samkei yo

lines: 1. He! Tingkau than mei ning e samkei o,
Alung zingc mei guay hei timaan lou o,
Ryanra zingc mei rui ata duam liam the;
Ting saeng gaichui pui Eden than gaimei.
He! Poubaomei kata karana khang,
Ringh mei duikhun ne nang Poubaomei;
Katik kagun daimei tingkao ramgai.
Nang ding e aniu ta gumliam lou o.
2. Reikhou Eden pilung khou bam pui tang,
Kandih paap sipui bamkhou bamlana.
Tingsaeng eden than gaimei tei ning e
Tingsaeng salem than gaimei tei nai e.
3. Nangzanc tei huai pukhou zingh mei maan e,
Bumaeng than mei kandih thuan ku puni,
Aram neihlaa ai rui sathai mak ge,
Hei tei ning na akhang ting gan pat the.
4. Kandih mun gaimei guai puang tuai puni
Neihlapui tuang guaini maan puni e,
He! Poubaomei lunvmuh tuaydat lak khe.
Hei tei akhang tingsaeng na puang puni.
